amends: evaluation (post hoc, exploratory); requested by the coordinator after arm B results
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (designated executor)
status: exploratory, post hoc. Written and committed before any matched-FPPI number (selection or val) was computed.
motivation: At a fixed source recall target, arms A (640) and B (1280) sit at different source FPPI and ceiling headroom, so their ceiling/threshold decompositions are not matched. Matching source FPPI compares resolution at equal clear-day false-positive cost.
selection_rule: For each arm and each FPPI level L, t*(L) = the lowest observed selection-split pedestrian candidate score s such that FP(score >= s)/images <= L on the selection split (whole tie groups inclusive; zero-area candidates count as FP). Undefined if even the top tie group exceeds L.
fppi_levels_rationale: A's lowest selection ceiling FPPI is 31.6 and B's operating points so far span 0.3-9 FPPI, so all four levels are reachable by every arm; 4.5 is near A's recall-0.70 operating point. Grid fixed without val data.
populations: pedestrian GT >= 32 px (shorter GT ignore regions, as amendment_2)
reported_per_condition: recall and FPPI at t*(L), candidate ceiling, loss vs val clear day split into ceiling and threshold parts (held_out_loss_decomposition), plus a per-condition oracle: the condition's own threshold at the same FPPI level and its recall. 95% image bootstrap, 1000 replicates, selection and test resampled independently (same seed and procedure as the frozen config).
comparison: B minus A at each L for night recall and both loss parts; bootstrap intervals for those differences use paired resampling of the same images for both arms (same predictions population, same image draws).
unchanged: matching, splits, candidates, preregistered and amendment_2 results
